name: Gas branch to Nyandoma GRS (Nyuksenitsa-Arkhangelsk system)
researcher_notes: Kommersant 2026-04-24 body text (from Gazprom transgaz Ukhta press service) says construction completed of a gas pipeline-branch 32.4 km long AND GRS Nyandoma 24.3 thousand m3/h; headline 'gas pipeline and GRS for 32.4 km' is ambiguous but body assigns 32.4 km to the pipe, so length is sourced (>=25 km). Energyland (2026-04-27) republishes the same press release: not independent. dvinainform.ru 2026-04-28 also covers it but 403s in url_verifier, not cited. Serves Nyandomsky, Konoshsky, Kargopolsky districts; 2021-2025 gasification programme; operated by Nyuksenitsa LPU MG. GRS complex-tested under load, 'ready for operation' -> status operating is slight inference (medium). Not in GGIT snapshot 20260930 (no Nyandoma/Konosha/Kargopol/Nyuksen rows). Start point/tie-in on the Nyuksenitsa-Arkhangelsk trunk not stated; diameter, pressure, cost not found; GRS 24.3k m3/h (~0.21 bcm/y) is station throughput, not entered as pipe capacity. Owner entity: entity_lookup has no Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta (only Romanian Transgaz); Gazprom PJSC exists as parent. No route found; route needs research from official GIS. Reviewer should confirm pipe-vs-GRS length from the primary Gazprom release.
